explanation: The observed downstream output violates the stipulated requirement to preserve demand record fields. Job 2 received all eight needs with record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight, but its coverage and priority records retain only record_id and need, dropping demand_score, source_id, and source_weight. The evidence supports localizing the fault to Job 2, but no function-level evidence is supplied.
cited_evidence: Behavioural criteria require: "Select all qualifying or fallback demand records and preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight."
Job 2 input needs include preserved fields, e.g. n06-r01 has demand_score 9, source_id s01, source_weight 5.
Observed Job 2 coverage records contain only capability_id, coverage, need, and record_id, omitting demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.
Observed Job 2 priority records contain capability_id, coverage, need, priority_rank, record_id, unsupported, and upstream_rank, but omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.
